findings.rationale: Real evidence gap: the 14 remaining P2.6 suites were run at c90c3e3b, one at a time, but their rc lines were never committed. Fixed: docs/plans/evidence/2026-10-12-worktree-placement/p2-6-suites.txt records each suite with rc=0 (dispatch-detach, dispatch-detached-campaign-authority, dispatch-worktree-lifecycle, dispatch-hetero-gc, worktree-reap, repo-residue-sweep, tmp-residue-registry, check-tmp-residue-registry, tmp-residue-prune, suite-residue-reaper, prune-tmp-residue, foreman-guard, foreman-guard-roles, test-doc-drift-gate), and the README P2 row now cites it.

Re-derived: the transitive require graph of scripts/resolve-repo-placement.js is 17 in-repo files with zero non-builtin specifiers (a walker over every require() from the script found none). 'Built-ins only' on a rail path means no npm dependency, which holds; reusing project-key is what D5 asks for. Noted in the README P2 row.

Not a regression: before this change (28ab4d92^, repo-residue-sweep.js:666) every cwd-busy worktree under .claude/worktrees was skipped. D10 only stops skipping those with a valid marker; a busy worktree with a malformed marker keeps the old behaviour, and is listed as soon as no process is inside it.

No defect, as the finding says: dispatch-batch has no main-checkout fingerprint, so main_checkout_mutated cannot arise there, and its sandbox is created fresh, so the merge-back assertion already runs on a first placement.

Same gap as the s0 finding: fixed by committing p2-6-suites.txt (14 suites, each rc=0 at c90c3e3b, run one at a time) and citing it from the README P2 row. The D9 files (allowlist, registry) are covered by check-tmp-residue-registry and tmp-residue-registry; D10 by repo-residue-sweep in addition to repo-residue-auto.

Verified as asked: the transitive require graph of resolve-repo-placement.js is 17 in-repo files with zero non-builtin specifiers, so the resolver runs in a dependency-free checkout today. Inlining would fork the D5 identity rule.

Direction is inverted: at repo-residue-sweep.js:669 a cwd-busy worktree under .claude/worktrees whose marker_valid is not true hits 'continue', so it is skipped, not listed. That skip is the behaviour before this change for every busy worktree there (28ab4d92^:666); nothing new is hidden.
Same evidence-completeness gap; fixed by p2-6-suites.txt and the README P2 row citing it.

Verified as asked: the transitive require graph is 17 in-repo files, none requiring a non-builtin module. The rail-path constraint (no npm dependency) holds; inlining scopeFromCwd would fork the identity rule D5 reuses.

Pre-existing behaviour retained, not introduced: before this change every cwd-busy worktree under .claude/worktrees was skipped (28ab4d92^:666). D10 narrows the skip to worktrees without a valid marker; a malformed-marker worktree is listed once it is no longer busy.
Same gap as s0/s1: fixed by committing p2-6-suites.txt (all 14 remaining P2.6 suites rc=0 at c90c3e3b, each run alone) and citing it from the README P2 row.
